source_text: Congregati cum senioribus consilium acceperunt ut darent pecuniam militibus, ut dicerent: Discipuli eius nocte furati sunt eum, dormientibus nobis. Qui legebant Non falsum testimonium dices alios ad falsum testimonium invitabant. Gloria Christo resurgenti. Amen.
orientation: Origen is commenting on Matthew 27:62-66, where the chief priests and elders bribe the soldiers to say that Jesus' disciples stole his body while they slept.
pass_a_gloss: Having been gathered together with [the] elders [a] plan they accepted that they should give money to [the] soldiers, that they should say: [The] disciples of him [by] night stole him, [while] sleeping [was] us. Those who were reading Not [a] false testimony you will say others to [a] false testimony were inviting. Glory to Christ rising again. Amen.

choices.why: Keeps the passive participle's force and the prepositional phrase, showing the chief priests are the implied subject acting together with the elders.
rejected: When they had assembled with the elders
The chief priests, gathered with the elders

choices.why: Preserves the idiom 'take counsel' and the plural subject implied by the context, matching the Gospel narrative.

choices.english: to give money to the soldiers
choices.why: Renders the purpose clause literally, keeping 'money' rather than a more specific coin term, since the source uses the general word.
rejected: so that they might pay the soldiers

choices.why: Keeps the direct object 'him' referring to Jesus' body, matching the soldiers' reported speech exactly.
Renders the ablative absolute literally, preserving the soldiers' own claim of being asleep.

choices.english: You shall not bear false witness
choices.why: Uses the standard English rendering of the commandment, matching the biblical citation Origen alludes to.
rejected: You shall not give false testimony

bible_refs.note: Congregati cum senioribus consilium acceperunt ut darent pecuniam militibus, ut dicerent: Discipuli eius nocte furati sunt eum, dormientibus nobis

pass_b_english: They gathered with the elders and took counsel to give money to the soldiers, so that they would say, “His disciples stole him during the night while we were sleeping.” Those who were reading “You shall not bear false witness” (Exodus 20:16) were inviting others to bear false witness. Glory to the risen Christ. Amen.

last_rejected.why: Origen cites the commandment without book/chapter; adding 'Exodus 20:16' is editorial, not in source.
last_rejected.fix: Those who were reading 'You shall not bear false witness' were inviting others to bear false witness.
last_rejected.ruling: Source quotes 'Non falsum testimonium dices'; adding Exodus 20:16 is a helpful scripture reference, not a meaning change.
